periods.time: Night of the fifth day at Fifth Camp, after Tatara's confession

name.zh: 艾莉丝揭露血染十字架惨案
name.en: Alice Reveals the Bloody Cross Past

periods.location: Improvised hot spring at Fifth Camp, Edelberg
periods.summary: Stella asks Alice why she fights Or-Gaule. Alice reveals that she and Or-Gaule were once siblings in a beloved French village, but on his tenth birthday he used his power to imprison and torture the villagers in the church for a week. The Bloody Cross incident ended when police arrived; Or-Gaule forced Alice's body to fight them while he escaped. Alice survived and devoted her life to atonement and to stopping her brother.
periods.cause: Stella wants to understand her teammates' battle motives before the representative war.
periods.process: Alice describes Or-Gaule's false charm, the birthday massacre, the police intervention, the cover-up by White-Robed Prime Minister, and her lifelong regret at not seeing the evil beside her.
periods.outcome: Stella trusts Alice's reason to fight and promises they will stop Or-Gaule together; Tatara watches in uneasy silence.
periods.significance: Defines Or-Gaule's irredeemable nature and Alice's personal stake in ending his violence.
